description: This file defines interfaces, enums, structures, and function prototypes for gateway provisioning abstraction, including DOCSIS and eSAFE configurations, TLV parsing, and network interface management.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables an eSafe device interface based on the provided mode.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes an eSafe device database with the device MAC address.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_AddeRouterPhysicalNetworkInterface
methods.description: Adds or deletes a physical network interface used by the erouter.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_SetErouterOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode of the erouter interface.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_SetProvisioningStatusProgress
methods.description: Sets the current provisioning status of the device.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_GetErouterOperationMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current operation mode of the erouter interface.

methods.name: eSafeDevice_SetServiceIntImpact
methods.description: Sets the service impact support status for the DOCSIS interface.

methods.name: getNetworkDeviceMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specified network device.

methods.name: getMultiCastGroupAddress
methods.description: Obtains the multicast group address for a given interface.

methods.name: setNetworkDeviceMacAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address for a specified network device.

methods.name: getInterfaceLinkLocalAddress
methods.description: Calculates the link-local address for a network interface.

methods.name: connectLocalBridge
methods.description: Connects or disconnects the DOCSIS local bridge.

methods.name: notifyDocsisInitializedResponse
methods.description: Sends an event notification indicating DOCSIS initialization completion.

methods.name: registerDocsisInitEvents
methods.description: Registers for DOCSIS initialization events.

methods.name: startDocsisCfgParsing
methods.description: Begins parsing the DOCSIS configuration file after TFTP transfer.

methods.name: initializeDocsisInterface
methods.description: Initializes resources for external DOCSIS interface.

methods.name: registerDocsisEvents
methods.description: Registers for all DOCSIS events to be handled by the provisioning state machine.

methods.name: SME_CreateEventHandler
methods.description: Creates the event handler state machine for DOCSIS stack events.

methods.name: notificationReply_CfgFileForEsafe
methods.description: Sends a notification reply regarding the esafe configuration file.

methods.name: getDocsisDbFactoryMode
methods.description: Retrieves the DOCSIS database factory mode (enabled/disabled).

methods.name: getWanMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the WAN interface.

methods.name: startWebUIProcess
methods.description: Starts the web GUI process.

methods.name: sendProcessReadySignal
methods.description: Signals that the process is ready for the next step.

methods.name: registerProcessExceptionHandlers
methods.description: Registers exception handlers for the process.

methods.name: parseTlv
methods.description: Parses TLV parameters from the esafe configuration file.

methods.name: sendTLV11toSnmpAgent
methods.description: Sends TR69 SNMP TLV11 configuration to the SNMP agent.
